headline: Rising mortgage rates could reduce house prices further
caption: The Reserve Bank's latest Financial Stability Review suggests mortgage rates may continue climbing, which could put further downward pressure on house prices across NZ. If you're thinking about buying or selling in East Auckland, this is important intel — understanding where rates are heading helps you make smarter timing decisions. Let's chat about what this means for your property goals! 🏡
